title: Aztec craft taken to Los Alamos then Wright Field
place_text: Los Alamos, New Mexico; Wright Field, Ohio

tellings.quote: the craft at Aztec was first taken to Los Alamos. But then it was taken to Wright airfield,

plain: A craft said to have crashed near Aztec, New Mexico, in 1948 was "first taken to Los Alamos" and then moved to Wright Field, the Air Force base in Ohio, according to Michels. He credits the account to a man named Scott Ramsey, who has looked into the Aztec case. If true, it would mean the wreck went first to the nuclear weapons lab and then to the Air Force's main technical base.
